name: phishy
description: Phish jam band meets gangster rap — psychedelic funk grooves with street-hard beats and 808 bass

style.instruments: guitar solos, funk bass, 808 kick, hi-hats, organ, turntable scratches
style.influences: Phish, NWA, Tupac, Snoop Dogg, Trey Anastasio, Dr. Dre

prompt_prefix: Psychedelic jam band meets gangster rap fusion, funky guitar licks over heavy 808 beats, improvised groove, gritty street flow

plan.energy: Smoky, head-nodding groove with cosmic haze — gritty street swagger riding a deep, hypnotic jam-band pocket, heavy and laid-back at once

main.prompt: Psychedelic jam band meets gangster rap fusion at 95 BPM in E minor. Funky guitar licks over heavy 808 beats: a greasy wah-wah guitar riff locks tight with a booming 808 kick and a slap bass funk groove, while Hammond organ swirls in psychedelic waves behind crisp turntable scratches and sparse, laid-back hi-hats. Improvised groove with a gritty street flow attitude — raw, smoky, head-nodding West Coast energy filtered through a cosmic jam-band lens. Clean, smooth production with a tight pocket and warm analog saturation; absolutely no glitch, no stutter, no chopped effects. Instrumental only, hypnotic and heavy, building subtle intensity like a live band riding one deep pocket for a full minute.

texture.prompt: Ambient psychedelic texture at 95 BPM in E minor: slow swirling Hammond organ drones, warm vinyl crackle, subtle tape hiss, hazy reverb-washed wah guitar echoes, and a deep sub rumble. Smooth, smoky, heady atmosphere with no percussion, no glitch, no stutter. Designed to layer under a funky jam-band hip-hop groove.
